description: This file implements a Wi-Fi driver for the SimpleLink hardware within the Zephyr RTOS, handling Wi-Fi events, scanning, connection management, and offloading features.

methods.name: simplelink_wifi_cb
methods.description: Handles Wi-Fi connection events, IP acquisition, and IPv6 acquisition, updating internal state and signaling connection readiness.

methods.name: simplelink_scan_work_handler
methods.description: Performs Wi-Fi scan results processing, retries scans if needed, and signals scan completion or failure.

methods.name: simplelink_mgmt_scan
methods.description: Initiates a Wi-Fi scan and schedules retries or completion callback.

methods.name: simplelink_dummy_get
methods.description: Placeholder for socket offload get operation, logs error if called.

methods.name: simplelink_iface_init
methods.description: Initializes the network interface, sets MAC address, initializes the SimpleLink hardware, and configures offload if enabled.

methods.name: simplelink_get_type
methods.description: Returns the type of network interface, indicating Wi-Fi offload.

methods.name: simplelink_init
methods.description: Initializes the driver, particularly the delayed work for scan retries.
